repos.name: Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard
repos.description: A full-stack AI Red Teaming platform securing AI ecosystems via Agent Scan, Skills Scan, MCP scan, AI Infra scan and LLM jailbreak evaluation.
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive full-stack AI Red Teaming platform designed to secure AI ecosystems and LLM deployments.
bullets: Built with Python to provide automated security scanning for AI infrastructure and agentic workflows.
Features specialized modules for MCP (Model Context Protocol) scanning, AI Infra auditing, and LLM jailbreak evaluation.
Addresses critical enterprise security needs by identifying vulnerabilities in AI-integrated software pipelines.
Essential for fintech and high-stakes environments where AI model integrity and data safety are paramount.

repos.name: Graphify-Labs/graphify
repos.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.
repos.one_liner: A tool that transforms complex codebases, SQL schemas, and documentation into a queryable knowledge graph.
bullets: Utilizes local deterministic AST parsing to map relationships between code, configs, and database schemas.
Integrates directly with Claude Code, Cursor, and other CLI tools as a specialized agent skill.
Enables developers to perform semantic queries across massive repositories to understand architectural dependencies.
Highly relevant for quant and fintech engineers needing to audit complex logic or legacy financial systems.

repos.name: modular/modular
repos.one_liner: A high-performance platform featuring the Mojo programming language and MAX engine for AI infrastructure.
bullets: Combines the usability of Python with the performance of C/C++ via the Mojo language.
Provides a unified AI engine (MAX) designed to optimize model inference across diverse hardware backends.
Focuses on low-latency execution, making it ideal for high-frequency trading or real-time AI inference.
Represents a significant shift in infrastructure tooling for developers building high-performance AI applications.

repos.name: wang2122/sprix-sage-router
repos.description: Sprix AI at 屿智同行 — state-aware SELF/COLLABORATE/HANDOFF routing for A2A agent networks.
repos.one_liner: A state-aware routing framework for agent-to-agent (A2A) networks supporting self-correction and collaboration.
bullets: Implements advanced routing logic for multi-agent systems, including SELF, COLLABORATE, and HANDOFF patterns.
Built in Python to manage complex agent workflows where tasks must be delegated or verified by specialized sub-agents.
Focuses on state-awareness to ensure consistency across distributed agent interactions.
A critical component for building scalable, agentic infrastructure in complex enterprise environments.

repos.name: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
repos.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
repos.one_liner: A CLI-based tool that provides AI agents with real-time, zero-fee access to major social and content platforms.
bullets: Enables agents to search and read data from Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, and other platforms without API costs.
Acts as a bridge for agents to ingest live market sentiment or technical discussions directly into their context window.
Simplifies the infrastructure required for agents to perform web-based research and data gathering.
Highly useful for quant researchers and fintech analysts looking to automate the ingestion of alternative data sources.
